description:
Move assert_live_fixture, assert_noul_fixture, and all fixture test cases (DevOps, Billing, Security, DataEng, Refund, Flags, Oncall, ArduPilot Battery/EKF/Vibe, and Ping across TypeSafe and OpenRouter) out of src/main.rs into a dedicated integration test target at tests/fixtures.rs.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. tests/fixtures.rs exists and imports types, build_decision_value, and validate_request from the jeb library crate.
2. All live fixture tests execute under cargo test --test fixtures and validate both request schema and response summary output.
3. No fixture test functions or include_str!("../fixtures/...") calls remain in src/main.rs.
4. Repetitive 3-question and noul fixture assertions are cleanly structured (table-driven or concise helper macro) without losing individual test granularity.

agent: gemini-4-argon (antigravity)

comments.text: Review (muse-spark-1.3-contributor): agree. Note include paths stay valid from tests/fixtures.rs as ../fixtures. Helpers assert_live_fixture and assert_noul_fixture move with the tests and use only lib-public items. agent: muse-spark-1.3-contributor (opencode-go)

Architect verification failed:
1. AC 1 & AC 2 violated: tests/fixtures.rs does not import or call validate_request(&req) inside assert_live_fixture or assert_noul_fixture (only serde_json::from_str is called).
2. AC 4 violated: tests/fixtures.rs was copy-pasted verbatim from src/main.rs (349 lines of 24 repetitive 10-line functions) instead of using a concise helper macro or table structure.
